overview: Two isolated Garbani Channel tarsals attributed to Purgatorius support ankle-mobility interpretations but do not establish a tooth-based species or crown-Primate membership.
overviewZh: Garbani Channel 的两件孤立踝骨被比较研究归入 Purgatorius；它们支持踝部活动性解释，但不能确定具名牙齿种或冠群灵长类成员资格。

ecology.diet: Diet cannot be tested from the isolated ankle bones.
ecology.habitat: The Garbani Channel setting identifies the fossil locality; it does not by itself establish the animal’s habitat.
ecology.locomotion: Ankle mobility and an inverted-foot capability are inferred from tarsal form.
ecology.bodySize: Small-bodied; body mass is estimated by comparison rather than measured.
ecology.guild: An arboreal locomotor interpretation is possible, but diet remains unknown.
ecology.dietZh: 孤立的踝骨无法检验食性。
ecology.habitatZh: Garbani Channel 的沉积环境标示了化石地点；仅凭这一点无法确定该动物的生境。
ecology.locomotionZh: 踝部活动能力和足部内翻能力是根据跗骨形态推断的。
ecology.bodySizeZh: 体型小；体重是通过比较估算，而非直接测量。
ecology.guildZh: 其运动方式可能适于树栖，但食性仍未知。

traits: Mobile upper ankle joint
Foot inversion inferred from tarsal anatomy
Isolated astragalus and calcaneus attributed by comparison
evidenceSummary: UCMP 197509 and UCMP 197517 are isolated tarsals; 65.2–64.4 Ma is sample context, not a genus range or crown-Primate age.

title.en: Two bones, with no associated teeth
title.zh: 两块孤立跗骨及其归属范围

text.en: The Garbani Channel sample consists of an astragalus and a calcaneus attributed to *Purgatorius*. Neither bone is associated with teeth, so the evidence is narrower than a complete species account.
text.zh: Garbani Channel 样本包括一块距骨和一块跟骨，研究通过比较分析将它们归入 *Purgatorius*。关节面支持踝部活动度较高及足部可能内翻的解释；但骨骼未与牙齿关联，不能确认其属于某个具名牙齿种，也不能据此确立冠群灵长类成员资格或直接祖先关系。

title.en: Mobility and inversion are comparative interpretations
title.zh: 踝部活动度与足内翻推断

text.en: Measurements and joint surfaces place the bones toward the mobile end of the comparison sample. That anatomy supports possible foot inversion and branch use, but it does not directly show climbing or the animal’s daily routine.
text.zh: 测量值与关节面比较显示，这些骨骼位于样本中踝部活动度较高的一端。这支持足部可能内翻、可能利用树枝的解释，但没有直接显示攀爬行为或日常活动。

title.en: Attribution to Purgatorius is not ancestry
title.zh: 跗骨归属不等于祖先关系

text.en: Comparative regressions and phylogenetic matrices support attribution to *Purgatorius*. They do not identify a dental species, establish membership in crown Primates or demonstrate a direct ancestor.
text.zh: 比较回归与系统发育矩阵支持将骨骼归入 *Purgatorius*，但不能确定其所属的牙齿种、确立冠群灵长类成员资格，也无法证明直接祖先关系。

title.en: Chester et al. (2015). Oldest known euarchontan tarsals and affinities of Paleocene Purgatorius to Primates.
title.zh: Chester 等（2015）：已知最早的灵长总目踝骨及古新世 Purgatorius 与灵长类的亲缘关系。

scope.en: Isolated Garbani Channel tarsals and comparative functional and taxonomic analyses; no associated dental skeleton.
scope.zh: 研究对象为 Garbani Channel 孤立跗骨及其比较功能、分类分析；没有与牙齿相连的骨架。

readerLimitations.en: The 65.2–64.4 Ma interval is the late-Puercan sample context, not a direct date on either bone or a genus-wide range. Tarsal attribution and arboreal movement are comparative interpretations; the sample does not resolve diet, population ecology or a direct place in primate ancestry.
readerLimitations.zh: 65.2–64.4 Ma 是晚 Puercan 期样本背景，不是两件骨骼的直接测年，也不是该属的完整延限。跗骨归属与树栖运动能力都是比较解释；样本无法确定食性、种群生态或其在灵长类祖先关系中的直接位置。

evidenceSummaryZh: UCMP 197509 和 UCMP 197517 是孤立跗骨；65.2–64.4 Ma 为样本背景，不是属级年代范围或冠群灵长类年代。
traitsZh: 根据跗骨解剖结构推断其足部可内翻。
通过比较归属的孤立距骨与跟骨。

overview: PMO 214.214 and WDC-MG-210 are the part and counterpart of one juvenile *Darwinius masillae* skeleton from Messel. Together they preserve articulated limbs, hands, the right foot, a complete tail, a soft-tissue outline and gut contents. The individual was juvenile, and fabricated preparation material was disclosed on part of counterplate B; anatomical completeness does not establish a settled tree position or direct ancestry.

ecology.diet: Plant material inferred from preserved gut contents
ecology.habitat: Messel lake ecosystem; habitual microhabitat remains inferred
ecology.locomotion: Arboreal quadrupedal interpretation from hands, feet and limbs
ecology.bodySize: Juvenile individual; adult body size cannot be read directly
ecology.guild: Small arboreal plant-eater inferred from one juvenile

traits: Complete tail and articulated limbs
Hands and right foot preserved
Soft-tissue outline and gut contents
evidenceSummary: Franzen and colleagues describe the juvenile Messel holotype PMO 214.214 and counterpart WDC-MG-210 as part and counterpart of one skeleton. The gut material preserves dietary evidence but does not establish a complete diet. Preparation concentrated on counterplate B, which limits what is exposed. The specimen does not establish direct ancestry.

title.en: PMO 214.214 and WDC-MG-210 are counterpart slabs
title.zh: PMO 214.214 与 WDC-MG-210 是同一骨架的正反面

text.en: At Messel, PMO 214.214 and WDC-MG-210 represent the two sides of one juvenile skeleton. Together they preserve a near-continuous outline with articulated limbs, hands, feet and tail. The counterpart surfaces help distinguish preserved anatomy from gaps or distortion associated with burial and preparation.
text.zh: 梅塞尔的 PMO 214.214 与 WDC-MG-210 代表同一具幼年骨架的两面，并非两只动物。合看两块石板，可见较连续的轮廓、关节连接的四肢、手、足和尾部。对照正反面有助于区分保存的解剖结构与埋藏或制备造成的缺损、变形。

title.en: Gut material belongs to one juvenile
title.zh: 肠道植物材料属于一只幼体的证据

text.en: The description records plant material in the gut region alongside a soft-tissue outline, teeth and limbs. These observations support a limited dietary interpretation for this individual. Because the skeleton is juvenile, it does not directly establish adult size or proportions, and its gut contents are not a species-wide diet.
text.zh: 描述记录了肠道区域的植物残留，以及软组织轮廓、牙齿和四肢。这些观察只支持对这一个体饮食的有限解释。由于骨架来自幼体，不能直接确定成体体型或比例；其肠内容物也不是整个物种的食谱。

title.en: Preparation history and phylogenetic placement are separate
title.zh: 制备记录与系统发育位置是不同问题

text.en: The original description discloses fabricated preparation material on part of counterplate B. Researchers have discussed the anatomical combination in relation to adapiform and anthropoid relationships, but this one skeleton cannot settle branching history or demonstrate a human ancestor. Preparation history, preserved anatomy and phylogenetic placement are distinct questions.
text.zh: 原始描述披露反板 B 的部分区域含有人工制备材料。研究者曾用其解剖特征组合讨论适应猴类和拟人猿类的关系，但一具骨架不能独自确定分支历史，也不能证明该动物是人类祖先。标本制备、保存的解剖结构和系统发育位置应分别理解。

title.en: Franzen et al. (2009). Complete Primate Skeleton from the Middle Eocene of Messel in Germany: Morphology and Paleobiology.
title.zh: Franzen 等（2009）：德国梅塞尔中始新世的完整灵长类骨架：形态与古生物学。

scope.en: The Messel juvenile part-and-counterpart holotype, its described anatomy, preparation disclosure and proposed paleobiology.
scope.zh: 梅塞尔幼体正反模正模及其解剖描述、制备说明和古生物学解释。

readerLimitations.en: This account follows one juvenile holotype and its original description. It does not provide population-level variation, a direct adult body-size estimate or a settled phylogenetic position. Preparation disclosures and interpretations remain tied to the specimen record.
readerLimitations.zh: 本文依据一件幼年正模及其原始描述，不是种群层面的综述，也不提供直接的成体体型估计或确定的系统发育位置。制备披露与形态解释均应回到这件标本的记录中理解。

commonNameZh: 狭鼻猴干群萨达猴标本
overview: Holotype SGS-UM 2009-002 is a partial adult cranium. A published 36-character comparison across 19 taxa found a stem-catarrhine position; the specimen has catarrhine-associated features but lacks diagnostic ape or Old World monkey specializations.

ecology.diet: Diet inferred from preserved dentition; direct feeding evidence absent
ecology.habitat: Shumaysi depositional setting; habitual habitat unresolved
ecology.locomotion: Not preserved by the partial cranium
ecology.bodySize: Known from a partial adult cranium; body mass is model dependent
ecology.guild: Dietary guild unresolved beyond dental inference

traits: Partial face, palate and dentition
Tubular ectotympanic
Matrix-defined stem-catarrhine character combination
evidenceSummary: The holotype and a 36-character matrix support a stem-catarrhine test. The 29–28 Ma age is biochronological; it does not directly date the crown split or identify an ancestor.

title.en: What survives in holotype SGS-UM 2009-002
title.zh: 正模保存的部分头骨

text.en: Saadanius is known from one partial adult cranium from the middle Shumaysi Formation of western Saudi Arabia. The face, palate, teeth and ear region survive, while most of the skeleton is unknown. This Oligocene fossil offers a limited cranial sample from a region with few comparable finds.
text.zh: Saadanius 由成年正模 SGS-UM 2009-002 的部分头骨代表，出自沙特阿拉伯西部 Shumaysi 组中部。面部、腭部、牙齿和耳区得以保存，骨架其余大部分未知。这件渐新世标本提供了有限的颅骨材料，产自同类化石较少的地区。

title.en: A stem-catarrhine result from coded characters
title.zh: 编码性状矩阵给出的干群位置

text.en: The authors compared the cranium with living and fossil catarrhines using a 36-character matrix of 19 taxa. Saadanius has catarrhine-associated features, including a tubular ectotympanic, but lacks specializations diagnostic of crown apes or Old World monkeys. Its stem placement depends on the coded characters and comparison set.
text.zh: 作者用涵盖 19 个类群的 36 项性状矩阵，将头骨同现生及化石狭鼻猴类比较。Saadanius 具有狭鼻猴类相关特征，包括管状鼓骨，却缺少冠群类人猿或旧世界猴的诊断性特化。干群位置取决于编码性状和比较对象。

title.en: Biochronology does not measure the split
title.zh: 生物年代学不是分化事件的直接测年

text.en: The paper assigns the fossil an age of roughly 29–28 Ma (about 29–28 million years ago) from formation biochronology. This frames a possible interval for catarrhine evolution; it is not a direct measurement of the ape–Old World monkey divergence. Stem placement does not identify Saadanius as a direct ancestor.
text.zh: 论文依据地层生物年代学，将化石置于约 29–28 Ma（约 2,900 万至 2,800 万年前）。该区间提供狭鼻猴演化的时间背景，却不是类人猿与旧世界猴分化时间的直接测量。干群位置也不能证明 Saadanius 是直系祖先。

title.en: Zalmout et al. (2010). New Oligocene primate from Saudi Arabia and the divergence of apes and Old World monkeys.
title.zh: Zalmout 等（2010）：沙特阿拉伯新发现的渐新世灵长类与类人猿、旧世界猴的分化。

scope.en: Partial Shumaysi Formation cranium, the paper’s character matrix and biochronological placement.
scope.zh: Shumaysi 组部分头骨、论文中的特征矩阵及生物年代学定位。

readerLimitations.en: The account rests on one partial cranium and one published character analysis. Biochronological age is not a direct divergence date, and the proposed stem-catarrhine position does not establish direct ancestry.
readerLimitations.zh: 本文依据一件部分头骨和一项已发表的性状分析。生物年代学年龄不是分化时间的直接测量；提出的狭鼻猴干群位置也不能证明直接祖先关系。

overview: This account follows small dental samples attributed to *Teilhardina* from the Hengyang Basin in China, Dormaal in Belgium and Wyoming’s Bighorn Basin. Their sections are correlated around the Paleocene–Eocene Thermal Maximum (PETM), about 56 Ma. The sampled order from Asia to Europe to North America is a reconstruction from separate local records, not a tracked population.

ecology.diet: Dental samples do not directly record diet
ecology.habitat: Section and carbon-isotope context, not habitual habitat
ecology.locomotion: Not preserved by the dental samples
ecology.bodySize: Body mass is not directly estimated from the reported sequence
ecology.guild: Ecological guild remains unresolved from these samples

traits: Separately catalogued dental samples
Dental comparisons across three PETM sections
No associated postcranial skeleton
evidenceSummary: Smith, Rose and Gingerich compare teeth and correlated sections on pages 11223–11227, Figures 1–3 and supporting tables. The proposed Asia–Europe–North America order depends on dental identifications and age correlations. It is not a directly observed migration route, a global first appearance or evidence of direct ancestry.

title.en: Dental samples from China, Belgium and Wyoming
title.zh: 来自中国、比利时和怀俄明州的牙齿

text.en: The paper compares small dental samples from the Hengyang Basin in China, Dormaal in Belgium and Wyoming’s Bighorn Basin. Each comes from a separate section. Putting them in one geographic order depends on the species identifications and correlation of the rock layers; the fossils do not record one group travelling between these sites.
text.zh: 论文比较了中国衡阳盆地、比利时 Dormaal 和美国怀俄明州 Bighorn 盆地的少量牙齿。每组样本来自不同地层剖面。将其排成地理顺序需要依赖物种鉴定和岩层对比；化石并未记录同一群动物在这些地点间移动。

title.en: A sampled order around the PETM
title.zh: PETM 前后所采样化石的顺序

text.en: The authors compare the teeth and section ages with the PETM, about 56 million years ago. Their correlations place the sampled *Teilhardina* records in Asia, then Europe and North America over a short interval. This is an order among fossils in correlated strata, not a continuous history of one population.
text.zh: 作者将牙齿与剖面年代和约 5600 万年前的 PETM 对照。对比结果把所采样的 *Teilhardina* 化石依次置于亚洲、欧洲和北美的短时间窗内。这是相关地层中化石样本的先后顺序，不是同一种群的连续历史。

title.en: Rapid dispersal is an interpretation of the sequence
title.zh: 快速扩散是对样本顺序的解释

text.en: Smith, Rose and Gingerich interpret the sampled order as rapid geographic dispersal. No route is preserved: species assignments, fossil sampling and age correlations affect the result. Teeth alone do not show how the animals moved or where they lived, and the earliest sampled record need not mark the genus’s global origin.
text.zh: Smith、Rose 与 Gingerich 将所采样的顺序解释为快速地理扩散。化石没有保存迁徙路线；物种鉴定、化石采样和年代对比都会影响结论。牙齿不能说明动物如何移动或栖居，最早的采样记录也未必代表该属的全球起源。

title.en: Smith, Rose & Gingerich (2006). Rapid Asia–Europe–North America geographic dispersal of earliest Eocene primate Teilhardina during the Paleocene–Eocene Thermal Maximum.
title.zh: Smith、Rose 与 Gingerich（2006）：古新世—始新世极热事件期间最早始新世灵长类 Teilhardina 在亚洲—欧洲—北美的快速地理扩散。

scope.en: Dental samples from three correlated sections and the paper’s PETM age and dispersal interpretation.
scope.zh: 三个对比地层剖面的牙齿样本，以及论文的 PETM 年代与扩散解释。

readerLimitations.en: This account covers small dental samples from three correlated sections. Their geographic order depends on identification and dating. The material is not a continuous migration record, a complete ecological study or a directly measured global first appearance.
readerLimitations.zh: 本文介绍来自三个相关地层剖面的少量牙齿样本。它们的地理顺序取决于鉴定和年代对比；这些材料不是连续迁徙记录、完整生态研究或直接测定的全球首次出现。

overviewZh: 本文介绍归入 *Teilhardina* 的少量牙齿，来自中国衡阳盆地、比利时 Dormaal 和美国怀俄明州 Bighorn 盆地。三个地层剖面被对比到约 5600 万年前的古新世—始新世极热事件（PETM）前后。从亚洲到欧洲再到北美的顺序，是依据彼此独立的地方记录重建，并非对同一迁徙种群的连续追踪。
evidenceSummaryZh: Smith、Rose 和 Gingerich 在第 11223–11227 页、图 1–3 及补充表中比较了牙齿与对应地层剖面。亚洲、欧洲和北美的先后顺序取决于牙齿鉴定和年代对比，并非直接观察到的迁徙路线、全球首次出现时间或直接祖先证据。

commonNameZh: 莫罗古猿姿势骨骼样本
overview: Shoulder specimen MUZM 60 from Moroto I and femur MUZM 80 from Moroto II anchor this Morotopithecus bishopi account. They are not one associated skeleton. The study compares each bone to reconstruct possible early Miocene hominoid movement.

ecology.diet: These two postcranial fossils provide no direct evidence of diet.
ecology.habitat: The Moroto localities give geological context; they do not directly establish the animal’s habitual habitat.
ecology.locomotion: Comparative functional analysis supports a mixed arboreal repertoire. This is a reconstruction from bones, not observed movement.
ecology.bodySize: Size estimates come from comparisons of the postcranial specimens and apply to this sample.
ecology.guild: Locomotion alone does not resolve the animal’s ecological guild.
ecology.dietZh: 这两件颅后骨骼化石没有提供直接的食性证据。
ecology.habitatZh: Moroto 化石地点提供地质背景，但不能直接确定该动物的习惯性生境。
ecology.locomotionZh: 比较功能分析支持其具有多样的树栖运动方式。这是根据骨骼作出的重建，并非观察到的运动。
ecology.bodySizeZh: 体型估计来自对这些颅后骨骼标本的比较，仅适用于这批样本。
ecology.guildZh: 仅凭运动方式不能确定该动物的生态类群。

traits: Shoulder anatomy in the Moroto sample
Femoral anatomy in the Moroto sample
Shoulder and femur belong to separate MUZM specimens
evidenceSummary: MacLatchy and colleagues compare MUZM 60 and MUZM 80 on pages 159–183, Figures 1–12 and Tables 1–10. Locality attribution, movement reconstruction and evolutionary placement are separate inferences; the bones do not record observed behavior or direct ancestry.

title.en: Shoulder and femur from different localities
title.zh: 肩部与股骨来自不同地点

text.en: The paper discusses shoulder material MUZM 60 from Moroto I and femur MUZM 80 from Moroto II, Uganda. They were not found together as one skeleton. Each is compared with other primates; the locality records frame each specimen separately.
text.zh: 论文讨论两件化石：来自 Moroto I 的肩部材料 MUZM 60，以及来自乌干达 Moroto II 的股骨 MUZM 80。它们并非同一具骨架。研究分别将两块骨骼与其他灵长类比较，地点记录用于说明各自样本背景。

title.en: A locomotor model from two bones
title.zh: 两块骨骼支持的运动方式模型

text.en: The study compares the shoulder and femur to assess possible movement. Together, their form supports a varied arboreal repertoire rather than a single label based on one bone. This is a functional reconstruction from fossil anatomy and comparison, not observed behavior.
text.zh: 研究比较肩部和股骨形态以评估可能的运动方式。两件材料共同支持多样的树栖运动能力，而非依据单块骨头贴上单一标签。这是从化石解剖结构和比较分析作出的功能重建，不是直接观察到的行为。

title.en: Movement does not establish ancestry
title.zh: 运动模型不能确立祖先关系

text.en: A locomotor model does not determine a place on the primate family tree. These two postcranial fossils do not form a complete skeleton, establish diet or habitat, or show that Morotopithecus directly gave rise to living apes.
text.zh: 运动模型本身不能决定它在灵长类谱系树中的位置。这两件头后骨骼不构成完整骨架，也不能确定饮食或栖地，更不能证明 Morotopithecus 是现生类人猿的直接祖先。

title.en: MacLatchy et al. (2000). Postcranial functional morphology of Morotopithecus bishopi, with implications for the evolution of modern ape locomotion.
title.zh: MacLatchy 等（2000）：Morotopithecus bishopi 的附肢功能形态及其对现代类人猿运动演化的启示。

scope.en: Comparative analysis of separate shoulder and femoral specimens from Moroto I and II; functional reconstruction is specimen bounded.
scope.zh: 比较 Moroto I、II 的分离肩部与股骨标本；功能重建受具体标本范围限制。

readerLimitations.en: This account follows a functional study of two separate postcranial fossils. It does not provide a complete skeleton, direct behavioral observations, a species-wide ecological profile or proof of direct ancestry.
readerLimitations.zh: 本页依据一项研究两件分离头后骨骼的功能分析，不是完整骨架、直接行为观察、物种整体生态档案或直接祖先关系的证明。

overviewZh: Moroto I 的肩部标本 MUZM 60 和 Moroto II 的股骨 MUZM 80，是 Morotopithecus bishopi 这项记述的依据。二者不是同一关联骨架的一部分。研究分别比较两块骨骼，以重建中新世早期人猿类可能的运动方式。
evidenceSummaryZh: MacLatchy 等人在第 159–183 页、图 1–12 和表 1–10 中比较 MUZM 60 与 MUZM 80。地点归属、运动方式重建和演化位置是彼此独立的推断；骨骼没有记录直接观察到的行为或直接祖先关系。
traitsZh: Moroto 样本中的肩部解剖特征。
Moroto 样本中的股骨解剖特征。
肩部和股骨来自不同的 MUZM 标本。

commonNameZh: 布里杰组北猴足部样本
overview: The semi-articulated AMNH 143612/143640 foot from Bridger B, Wyoming, preserves phalanges that can be assigned to individual digits. Their shape and joint relationships support a grooming-claw interpretation on digit two. This 50–48.5 Ma locality interval describes one foot sample; it records anatomy, not grooming, the genus-wide range, direct ancestry or crown-group membership.

ecology.diet: The foot does not record diet.
ecology.habitat: The Bridger Formation locates the fossils, but not the animal's habitual microhabitat.
ecology.locomotion: Foot proportions allow functional comparison; locomotion was not observed.
ecology.bodySize: This foot sample does not establish a population-wide body-size estimate.
ecology.guild: The foot anatomy does not identify an ecological role.
ecology.habitatZh: Bridger 组确定了化石产地，但没有确定该动物通常利用的微生境。
ecology.locomotionZh: 足部比例可用于功能比较；运动方式并未被直接观察。
ecology.bodySizeZh: 这批足部样本不能确定种群层面的体型估计。
ecology.guildZh: 足部解剖特征无法确定其生态作用。

traits: Semi-articulated foot represented by AMNH 143612 and AMNH 143640
Toe bones assigned to individual digits
Grooming-claw function inferred for digit two
evidenceSummary: The study centers on one semi-articulated foot catalogued as AMNH 143612 and AMNH 143640. Its phalanges support a digit-two grooming-claw interpretation, but do not record grooming behavior or show that every *Notharctus* had the same anatomy.

title.en: One Bridger foot under two AMNH numbers
title.zh: Bridger 一只足部，两组 AMNH 编号

text.en: The paper treats AMNH 143612 and AMNH 143640 as a semi-articulated *Notharctus* foot from Wyoming's Bridger B locality. Several phalanges retain positions that allow assignment to individual digits. The two catalogue numbers describe one bounded foot sample, not two animals or a complete skeleton.
text.zh: 论文研究了来自怀俄明 Bridger B 地点的一只半关节连接 *Notharctus* 足部，馆藏编号为 AMNH 143612 和 AMNH 143640。几块趾骨仍保留位置，可据此分配到不同脚趾。两个编号指向同一足部样本，不是两只动物，也不代表完整骨架。

title.en: Why the study places the claw on digit two
title.zh: 研究为何把梳理爪位置判在第二趾

text.en: The authors compared the shape and joint relationships of phalanges assigned to different digits. Their interpretation places the grooming claw on digit two rather than the digit-one position often proposed for adapiforms. This is a functional reading of the bones; grooming itself was not observed.
text.zh: 作者比较分配到不同脚趾的趾骨形态与关节关系，将梳理爪解释为位于第二趾，而非适应猴类过去常提出的第一趾位置。这是对骨骼功能的解释；研究没有观察到 *Notharctus* 实际梳理。

title.en: A foot cannot establish behavior or ancestry
title.zh: 一只足部不能代表行为或祖先关系

text.en: The proposed digit assignment can be compared with other primate feet, but this specimen cannot show grooming frequency, why the animal groomed, or whether other individuals shared the same claw. One foot can test a functional hypothesis; it cannot establish behavior across the genus or direct ancestry.
text.zh: 推测的趾位可与其他灵长类足部比较，但这件标本不能说明梳理频率、梳理原因，也不能证明其他个体有相同爪位。一只足部可以检验功能假说，却不能确定整个属的行为或直系祖先关系。

title.en: Maiolino et al. (2012). Evidence for a Grooming Claw in a North American Adapiform Primate: Implications for Anthropoid Origins.
title.zh: Maiolino 等（2012）：北美适应猴类梳理爪的证据及其对拟人猿类起源的意义。

scope.en: Ray-specific comparisons of the named Notharctus foot material AMNH 143612/143640; functional interpretation, not observed grooming.
scope.zh: 针对具名 Notharctus 足部标本 AMNH 143612/143640 的分趾比较；结论属于功能解释，不是梳理行为观察。

readerLimitations.en: This account follows one semi-articulated foot and a function inferred from its phalanges. It does not document grooming behavior or frequency, population-wide variation, a global range for *Notharctus*, or direct anthropoid ancestry.
readerLimitations.zh: 本文介绍一只半关节连接足部及其趾骨所支持的功能解释。它没有记录实际梳理行为及其频率、种群整体变异、*Notharctus* 的全球分布或其与拟人猿的直接祖先关系。

overviewZh: 怀俄明 Bridger B 的半关节连接足部 AMNH 143612/143640 保存了可按趾位比较的趾骨。其形态与关节关系支持第二趾可能具有梳理爪的功能解释。50–48.5 Ma 是地点样本的年代背景；这件足部并未记录实际梳理，也不能确定该属的全球分布、直系祖先关系或冠群归属。
evidenceSummaryZh: 研究的核心材料是一只半关节连接的足部，馆藏编号为 AMNH 143612 和 AMNH 143640。趾骨比较支持第二趾梳理爪的功能性解释，但没有观察到梳理行为，也不能说明所有 *Notharctus* 都有相同解剖特征。
traitsZh: AMNH 143612 和 AMNH 143640 代表的半关节连接足部。
归属于不同趾位的趾骨。
推断第二趾具有理毛爪功能。

commonNameZh: 中始新世曙猿孤立跗骨样本
overview: The study attributes isolated calcanei and tali from Shanghuang fissure fillings and the Yuanqu Basin to Eosimias. A comparative matrix supports anthropoid affinity, but the ankle bones are not associated with teeth, so their attribution and tree position remain inferences. The 45–40.5 Ma interval describes these localities, not the genus's full range.

ecology.diet: The ankle bones do not record diet.
ecology.habitat: Fissure-fill and basin deposits locate the finds; neither establishes habitual habitat.
ecology.locomotion: Ankle shape allows comparison, but the fossils do not show observed movement or a complete gait.
ecology.bodySize: Body-size estimates from isolated ankle bones are comparative, not a population estimate.
ecology.guild: The sampled ankle bones do not identify an ecological role.
ecology.habitatZh: 裂隙充填沉积和盆地沉积标明了化石发现地点；两者都不能确定其惯常栖息环境。
ecology.locomotionZh: 踝骨形态可用于比较，但化石未显示可直接观察的运动或完整步态。
ecology.bodySizeZh: 根据孤立踝骨估算的体型用于比较，并非种群体型估计。
ecology.guildZh: 取样的踝骨不能确定其生态作用。

traits: Isolated heel and ankle bones (calcanei and tali)
Separate locality samples from Shanghuang and Yuanqu
A mix of ankle features assessed in an anthropoid-affinity analysis
evidenceSummary: The study tests selected ankle characters from Shanghuang and Yuanqu. The fossils are not a complete foot and are not associated with teeth used to define Eosimias. The 45–40.5 Ma interval is locality context; anthropoid placement depends on the comparative matrix.

title.en: Calcanei and tali from Shanghuang and Yuanqu
title.zh: Shanghuang 与 Yuanqu 的跟骨和距骨

text.en: The study describes isolated heel bones (calcanei) and ankle bones (tali) from Shanghuang fissure fillings and the Yuanqu Basin in China. These are not a complete foot attached to teeth or a skull. Attribution to Eosimias rests on anatomical comparison, so both the isolated material and its two localities matter.
text.zh: 研究描述了来自中国 Shanghuang 裂隙充填物与 Yuanqu 盆地的孤立跟骨和距骨。它们不是与牙齿或头骨相连的完整足部。将这些骨骼归入 Eosimias 依据的是解剖比较，因此理解结论时需保留标本孤立和地点不同这两个条件。

title.en: Anthropoid affinity from a character matrix
title.zh: 比较矩阵如何支持类人猿亲缘

text.en: The authors scored ankle features in a comparative matrix. The fossils preserve a mixture of characters, and the placement depends on the characters and fossil comparisons included. Anthropoid affinity is the analysis result, not a label directly visible on one bone.
text.zh: 作者将踝部特征录入比较矩阵。骨骼保存的是一组组合特征，其位置取决于纳入比较的性状和化石。因此，类人猿亲缘是分析结果，不是单块骨头上直接可见的分类标签。

title.en: Separate inferences, incomplete anatomy
title.zh: 分类归属与系统位置是不同推断

text.en: The tarsals are not associated with the teeth used to define Eosimias. They do not show the animal's full movement, diet or habitual habitat. Attributing them to the genus and placing that genus on a tree are separate inferences; neither makes the ankle bones a complete anatomical record.
text.zh: 这些跗骨并未与用于界定 Eosimias 的牙齿关联，无法揭示动物完整的运动方式、食性或惯常栖地。把骨骼归入该属，与判断该属在演化树上的位置，是两个不同的推断；这组踝骨不能代表整只动物。

title.en: Gebo et al. (2000). The oldest known anthropoid postcranial fossils and the early evolution of higher primates.
title.zh: Gebo 等（2000）：已知最早的拟人猿类附肢化石与高等灵长类早期演化。

scope.en: Isolated Shanghuang and Yuanqu tarsals and their comparative character-matrix test; not a dentally associated skeleton.
scope.zh: Shanghuang 与垣曲孤立跗骨及其比较特征矩阵检验；没有与牙齿相连的骨架。

readerLimitations.en: The account covers isolated ankle bones and their comparison with other fossils. Without associated teeth or a complete foot, these specimens cannot establish full anatomy, habitual movement, ecology or direct ancestry.
readerLimitations.zh: 本页介绍孤立踝骨及其比较归属。由于这些化石没有与牙齿或完整足部关联，不能确立动物完整的解剖、惯常运动方式、生态或直接祖先关系。

overviewZh: 研究者将来自中国 Shanghuang 裂隙充填物和 Yuanqu 盆地的孤立跟骨与距骨归属到 Eosimias。比较矩阵支持其与类人猿支系有亲缘关系，但踝骨未与牙齿关联，因此分类归属和系统树位置仍属推断。45–40.5 Ma 描述的是这些产地，不是整个属的完整分布范围。
evidenceSummaryZh: 该研究用 Shanghuang 和 Yuanqu 的踝部特征测试孤立化石的归属。它们不是完整足部，也未与用于界定 Eosimias 的牙齿关联。45–40.5 Ma 是地点年代背景；接近类人猿的位置取决于比较矩阵。
traitsZh: 来自 Shanghuang 和 Yuanqu 的不同地点样本。
在类人猿亲缘关系分析中评估的一组踝部特征。

overview: COL26.8 usage 4C92G is the accepted species record. Selected evidence ranges from one Bossou wild community and task-specific stick use to Gombe life-history records, care-setting comparisons and population-genomic models. The results do not form one species-wide pattern.

ecology.diet: The Bossou study records feeding locations, not a species-wide diet.
ecology.habitat: Mature forest was the most selected habitat overall in the sampled Bossou community. This is a site-level result.
ecology.locomotion: The selected habitat-use study did not assess locomotion.
ecology.bodySize: The selected habitat-use study did not assess body size.
ecology.guild: A one-site habitat-use study does not establish a species-wide ecological guild.
ecology.dietZh: Bossou 研究记录了取食地点，但没有综合整个物种的食谱。
ecology.habitatZh: 在 Bossou 受研究群体中，整体上选择成熟林的比例最高。这是一个地点的结果。
ecology.locomotionZh: 所选栖地利用研究没有评估运动方式。
ecology.bodySizeZh: 所选栖地利用研究没有评估体型。
ecology.guildZh: 单一地点的栖地利用研究不能确定整个物种的生态功能群。

evidenceSummary: Researchers followed one wild community at Bossou daily for a year, including 10 adult focal individuals. These observations address local habitat and feeding use; they do not establish species-wide habitat use or a current range-wide synthesis.

context.en: Continue with another featured primate introduction.
context.zh: 继续阅读另一篇精选灵长类物种介绍。

title.en: Different samples answer different questions
title.zh: 不同样本回答不同问题

text.zh: 贡贝雌性生命史记录、Bossou 栖地和取食观察、Taï 棍棒使用视频、不同照护环境的体重比较及基因组模型，分别回答不同问题。应保留各自的种群和样本范围。
text.en: Gombe female life-history records, Bossou habitat and feeding observations, Taï stick-use videos, care-setting body-mass comparisons and genomic models each address different questions. Their populations and samples should remain separate.

title.en: A dated account of chimpanzee range
title.zh: 带有年代的黑猩猩分布记录

text.en: The 2016 IUCN assessment described a discontinuous range exceeding 2.6 million km², from southern Senegal across the forest belt north of the Congo River to western Tanzania and western Uganda, with four subspecies ranges. This is a dated account, not a current range map.
text.zh: IUCN 2016 年评估记载，黑猩猩不连续分布，面积超过 260 万平方公里，从塞内加尔南部沿刚果河以北的森林带延伸至坦桑尼亚西部和乌干达西部，并分别描述四个亚种的分布。这是一份有年代的记录，不是当前分布图。

title.en: Bossou feeding locations near fields
title.zh: Bossou 耕地附近的取食地点

text.en: At Bossou, Guinea, researchers followed one wild western chimpanzee community for up to six hours daily from April 2012 to March 2013; the focal sample included 10 adults. Mature forest was most selected overall. In uncultivated habitat, feeding records more than 200 m from fields exceeded chance expectations, while records in 0–200 m bands fell below them. This is a local result, not a species-wide habitat rule.
text.zh: 几内亚 Bossou 研究者在 2012 年 4 月至 2013 年 3 月跟踪一个野生西部黑猩猩群体，每天至多观察 6 小时；焦点样本包括 10 只成年个体。成熟林总体选择比例最高。在非耕地栖地中，距耕地超过 200 米的取食记录高于随机预期，0–200 米范围内则低于预期。这是局地结果，不是全物种规律。

title.en: Stick grips in one Taï foraging task
title.zh: Taï 特定取食任务中的棍棒握法

text.en: A video study at Taï recorded 1,460 stick-use events from 70 wild western chimpanzees across three neighboring communities. In the model for grips used to insert sticks, the multi-digit grip became predominant at about 5.2 years, with a 98% predicted probability by age 15. Only three females from one community contributed observations above 45 years. This is task- and sample-specific, not a universal developmental curve.
text.zh: 科特迪瓦 Taï 国家公园的一项视频研究记录了三个相邻野生西部黑猩猩群体中 70 只个体的 1,460 次棍棒使用事件。针对插入棍棒时的握法模型估计，多指握法约在 5.2 岁成为主导，到 15 岁时预测使用概率为 98%。45 岁以上观察仅来自一个群体的 3 只雌性。这一模式仅适用于所研究任务和样本。

title.en: Gombe estimates of maturity and first birth
title.zh: 贡贝种群的成熟与首次生育估计

text.en: Long-term records at Gombe covered 36 known-age wild females. Mean age at sexual maturity was 11.5 years and mean age at first birth was 14.9 years. First-birth estimates came from a smaller, censored subset overrepresenting non-dispersing females and may be biased low. These are estimates for one population.
text.zh: 坦桑尼亚西部贡贝国家公园长期记录涵盖 36 只已知年龄的野生雌性。性成熟平均年龄为 11.5 岁，首次生育平均年龄为 14.9 岁。首次生育估计来自较小且有删失的子样本，其中未迁出雌性偏多，数值可能偏低。这是一个种群的估计。

title.en: Body mass across three care settings
title.zh: 三种照护环境中的体重比较

text.en: A study compared 298 chimpanzees in African sanctuaries, 1,030 in zoos and 442 in research facilities. After age adjustment, adults in zoos and research facilities had greater body mass than sanctuary animals in both sexes; estimated growth was slower in the sanctuary cohort. Mixed or unknown subspecies and care settings limit interpretation.
text.zh: 一项研究比较了非洲救护中心的 298 只黑猩猩、动物园的 1,030 只和研究机构的 442 只。年龄校正后，动物园和研究机构成年个体的体重在雌雄中都高于救护中心；救护中心队列估计生长较慢。亚种混杂或未知，照护环境也不同，因此结论适用范围有限。

title.en: A model of chimpanzee population history
title.zh: 黑猩猩种群历史模型

text.en: A whole-genome site-pattern study sampled central, eastern, Nigeria–Cameroon and western chimpanzee lineages alongside bonobos. Its best-fitting model estimated gene flow from western into eastern chimpanzees and placed the shared ancestor of the four sampled chimpanzee lineages at about 987,000 years ago. These are model-based estimates, not fossil dates.
text.zh: 一项全基因组位点模式研究采样了中部、东部、尼日利亚—喀麦隆和西部四个黑猩猩谱系，并纳入倭黑猩猩。拟合最佳模型估计西部向东部黑猩猩发生基因流动，并将四个受采样谱系的共同祖先时间估为约 987,000 年前。这些是种群史模型估计，不是化石年代。

title.en: A 2013 regional estimate for central chimpanzees
title.zh: 中部黑猩猩的 2013 年区域估计

text.en: A spatial model estimated 128,760 weaned central chimpanzees in Western Equatorial Africa in 2013 (95% CI 114,208–317,039), with 80.7% of this subspecies in the modeled region outside the protected-area network. This is a historical regional model. The cited IUCN assessment is version 2016-2, with 2018 errata; its category is not stated as verified current status.
text.zh: 一项空间模型估算，2013 年西赤道非洲有 128,760 只已断奶的中部黑猩猩（95% 置信区间：114,208–317,039）；模型还估计，该区域内这一亚种的 80.7% 位于保护区网络之外。这是历史时期的区域模型。所引 IUCN 评估为 2016-2 版，2018 年有勘误；这里不将其类别表述为经核实的当前状态。

title.en: Humle et al. (2016). Pan troglodytes. The IUCN Red List of Threatened Species, version 2016-2.
title.zh: Humle 等（2016）：Pan troglodytes，《IUCN 受威胁物种红色名录》2016-2 版。

scope.en: Dated species-level assessment with a 2016 range account and status; errata were published in 2018. It is not verified here as the current Red List assessment.
scope.zh: 有年代的物种级评估，分布记述与状态来自 2016 版，2018 年发布勘误；此处未将其核实为当前红色名录评估。

title.en: Bryson-Morrison et al. (2017). Activity and habitat use at Bossou, Guinea.
title.zh: Bryson-Morrison 等（2017）：几内亚 Bossou 的活动与栖地利用研究。

scope.en: One wild P. t. verus community at Bossou, followed from April 2012 to March 2013; 10 adult focal individuals.
scope.zh: 2012 年 4 月至 2013 年 3 月在 Bossou 跟踪一个野生 P. t. verus 群体，焦点样本为 10 只成年个体。

title.en: Malherbe et al. (2024). Protracted development of stick tool use skills in wild western chimpanzees.
title.zh: Malherbe 等（2024）：野生西部黑猩猩棍棒工具使用技能的延长发育。

scope.en: Cross-sectional video study of three neighboring Taï communities, November 2013–April 2020; stick-based extractive-foraging tasks.
scope.zh: 2013 年 11 月至 2020 年 4 月对 Taï 三个相邻群体开展的横断面视频研究，观察棍棒取食任务。

title.en: Walker et al. (2018). Maturation is prolonged and variable in female chimpanzees.
title.zh: Walker 等（2018）：雌性黑猩猩的成熟期延长且存在差异。

scope.en: Long-term life-history records for known-age wild females at Gombe, western Tanzania; 36 females in the maturation analysis.
scope.zh: 坦桑尼亚西部贡贝的野生雌性长期生活史记录；成熟分析纳入 36 只已知年龄个体。

title.en: Curry et al. (2023). Body mass and growth rates in captive chimpanzees across care settings.
title.zh: Curry 等（2023）：不同照护环境下圈养黑猩猩的体重与生长速度。

scope.en: Comparison of sanctuary, zoo and research cohorts with mixed or unavailable subspecies; not a wild body-size estimate.
scope.zh: 比较救护中心、动物园与研究机构队列；亚种混合或未知，不是野生体型估计。

title.en: Brand et al. (2022). Estimating bonobo and chimpanzee evolutionary history from nucleotide site patterns.
title.zh: Brand 等（2022）：从核苷酸位点模式估计倭黑猩猩与黑猩猩的演化史。

scope.en: Whole-genome site-pattern analysis across the five extant Pan lineages; history and dates are model estimates.
scope.zh: 覆盖现生 Pan 五个谱系的全基因组位点模式分析；历史与年代均为模型估计。

title.en: Strindberg et al. (2018). Guns, germs, and trees determine density and distribution of gorillas and chimpanzees in Western Equatorial Africa.
title.zh: Strindberg 等（2018）：武器、病原与森林影响西赤道非洲大猩猩和黑猩猩的密度与分布。

scope.en: Historical 2013 model estimate for central chimpanzees in Western Equatorial Africa, not the whole species.
scope.zh: 对西赤道非洲中部黑猩猩亚种的 2013 年历史模型估计，不代表整个物种。

readerLimitations.en: These examples do not provide a current range or conservation assessment, or a broad synthesis of wild diet, locomotion and morphology. Each result remains tied to its study population, task, model and period.
readerLimitations.zh: 这些研究没有提供当前分布或保育评估，也未综合野外食性、运动方式和形态。每项结果仍受研究种群、任务、模型和时期限制。

overviewZh: COL26.8 usage 4C92G 是接受的物种记录。所选证据从 Bossou 一个野生群体和特定任务中的棍棒使用，延伸到贡贝生命史记录、照护环境比较与种群基因组模型；这些结果不构成全物种统一模式。
evidenceSummaryZh: 研究者连续一年每天跟踪 Bossou 一个野生群体，焦点样本包括 10 只成年个体。这些观察说明局地栖地和取食利用，不能确定全物种栖地利用或当前全分布区情况。

geography: Buxa Tiger Reserve, West Bengal, India (one troop study site)
Cayo Santiago, Puerto Rico (managed free-ranging morphology study population)
overview: COL26.8 accepts Macaca mulatta. The selected studies cover Chinese population genomics, one wild troop near Buxa, managed Cayo Santiago cohorts and an 11-km NH-7 road segment. They address different populations and questions, not one range-wide ecological profile.

ecology.diet: At Buxa, fruit accounted for 70.8% of recorded diet in the study-defined May–September non-provisioning period and 28.8% in the October–April provisioning period for one 64-individual troop.
ecology.habitat: The selected Buxa troop home range included patches of natural forest, mixed-species plantations and residential settlements; this is one local study setting, not a full habitat account.
ecology.locomotion: The selected studies do not assess locomotion.
ecology.bodySize: The Buxa troop study did not estimate body size. A separate Cayo Santiago study measured a defined cohort of adult males and female relatives.
ecology.guild: The selected studies do not assign an ecological guild.
ecology.locomotionZh: 所选研究没有评估运动方式。
ecology.bodySizeZh: Buxa 猴群研究没有估计体型。另一项 Cayo Santiago 研究测量了一个界定明确的成年雄猴及其雌性亲属群体。
ecology.guildZh: 所选研究没有为其指定生态功能类群。

traits: In one 2015 Cayo Santiago pedigree sample, most measured male morphometric traits were heritable under the study’s pooled models; this cohort result is not species-wide.
evidenceSummary: The evidence includes 81 macaques at 17 Chinese sites, one 64-member Buxa troop, Cayo Santiago pedigree and mating-season cohorts, and 54 road deaths on an 11-km NH-7 segment in 2009?2010. The road count is local, not a population mortality estimate or current conservation assessment.

title.en: Separate populations, measures and questions
title.zh: 恒河猴：不同研究群体中的体形与取食

text.zh: 恒河猴的体形、取食和繁殖不能由单一群体概括。圣地亚哥岛的谱系队列、印度野生群体、中国遗传样本和公路死亡记录对应不同样本与问题；阅读时应分别保留其范围。
text.en: Morphometrics and pedigree records come from managed Cayo Santiago macaques; feeding and travel were observed in a wild Buxa troop; Chinese samples were used for population genomics. Keeping those settings separate is necessary to interpret each result.

title.en: One species, several study populations
title.zh: 研究地点与群体各不相同

text.en: The pinned COL26.8 checklist accepts Macaca mulatta. The studies here sampled wild macaques in China and India, as well as managed free-ranging groups at Cayo Santiago, Puerto Rico. These settings address different questions and do not combine into a range-wide ecological portrait.
text.zh: 这里的恒河猴对应固定版本 COL26.8 接受的 Macaca mulatta。材料来自中国和印度的野生群体，也来自波多黎各圣地亚哥岛受管理的自由活动群体；不能把这些地点拼成全分布区的生活画像。

title.en: Five lineages in sampled Chinese populations
title.zh: 中国样本中的五个遗传谱系

text.en: A population-genomic study sampled 81 wild rhesus macaques at 17 sites across China, representing five subspecies. It identified five genetic lineages and evidence of recent gene flow. These results describe the sampled Chinese populations and the study's models, not a global species tree or complete range map.
text.zh: 一项群体基因组研究分析了中国 17 个地点的 81 只野生恒河猴，涵盖五个亚种。研究识别出五个遗传谱系，并报告近期基因流动证据。这些结果描述的是受采样的中国种群及其分析模型，不是全球完整谱系或分布图。

title.en: Seasonal diet and travel in one Buxa troop
title.zh: 布克萨一个群体的季节性取食与活动距离

text.en: Researchers followed one 64-member troop near Buxa from October 2013 to September 2014. In the study-defined May?September non-provisioning period, fruit was 70.8% of recorded diet and mean daily travel was 4.72 km; during October?April provisioning, the values were 28.8% and 2.58 km. The comparison does not isolate every seasonal influence.
text.zh: 2013 年 10 月至 2014 年 9 月，研究者跟踪了布克萨附近一个 64 只恒河猴群体。按论文划分，5—9 月非投喂期水果占记录饮食的 70.8%，平均日活动距离为 4.72 公里；10—4 月投喂期分别为 28.8% 和 2.58 公里。比较没有排除所有季节因素。

title.en: A Cayo Santiago pedigree sample
title.zh: 圣地亚哥岛的谱系测量样本

text.en: A 2015 study measured 125 adult males and 21 female relatives at Cayo Santiago. Under pooled pedigree models, several male traits, including body mass, crown?rump length and canine length, met the authors' heritability criterion; testicular volume did not and its estimate was imprecise. This managed cohort is not a morphology survey of the native range.
text.zh: 2015 年圣地亚哥岛研究测量了 125 只成年雄性和 21 只雌性亲属，并使用谱系模型分析。体重、头臀长和犬齿长等若干雄性特征达到作者的遗传率标准；睾丸体积未达到，估计也不精确。这是受管理群体，不代表原生分布区整体形态。

title.en: Paternity sampled at one year
title.zh: 满一岁时进行亲子取样的交配季研究

text.en: During the 2013 mating season, researchers followed 21 high-ranking males aged 7?21 across nine provisioned, semi-free-ranging groups. Older males were associated with fewer offspring recorded by the study. Paternity was sampled at one year, so infants that died earlier were not assigned; this is not lifetime reproductive success.
text.zh: 2013 年交配季，研究者在九个补饲、半自由活动群体中跟踪了 21 只 7—21 岁的高等级雄性。记录显示较年长雄性对应较少后代。亲子鉴定在幼体满一岁时进行，之前死亡的幼体没有归属父亲；该结果不是终生繁殖成功率。

title.en: Road deaths on one NH-7 segment
title.zh: NH-7 一段路上的死亡记录

text.en: From August 2009 to July 2010, observers recorded 54 rhesus macaques killed along an 11-km National Highway 7 segment near Pench: 27 in summer, 19 in winter and eight during the monsoon. These are local road observations, not a population mortality rate or current threat assessment.
text.zh: 2009 年 8 月至 2010 年 7 月，研究者在潘奇附近国家公路 7 号的一段 11 公里路段记录到 54 只恒河猴死亡：夏季 27 只、冬季 19 只、季风期 8 只。这些是局地公路记录，不是种群死亡率或当前威胁评估。

scope.zh: 五个亚种的 81 只野生个体，来自中国 17 个地点；谱系与基因流结果限于该样本和模型。

title.en: Sengupta et al. (2015), provisioning and primate ecological functions
title.zh: Sengupta 等（2015）：投喂与灵长类生态功能

scope.en: One 64-member Buxa troop observed October 2013–September 2014; periods were classified by provisioning.
scope.zh: 2013 年 10 月至 2014 年 9 月观察布克萨一个 64 只群体；研究按是否投喂划分时期。

title.en: Kimock et al. (2019), male morphology at Cayo Santiago
title.zh: Kimock 等（2019）：圣地亚哥岛雄性形态测量

scope.en: A 2015 pedigree sample of managed free-ranging macaques, not wild-origin populations across the species range.
scope.zh: 2015 年受管理自由活动群体的谱系样本，不代表全分布区野生来源种群。

title.zh: Sobral 等（2024）：高等级雄性的装饰与繁殖结果

scope.en: 21 males in nine Cayo Santiago groups during the 2013 mating season; paternity sampling began at the yearling stage.
scope.zh: 2013 年交配季圣地亚哥岛九群体中的 21 只雄性；亲子鉴定从幼体一岁时开始。

title.zh: Pragatheesh（2011）：国家公路 7 号的恒河猴道路死亡

scope.zh: 潘奇附近一段 11 公里道路的一年监测；观察到的死亡数不是种群死亡率。

readerLimitations.en: These sources do not establish a current global range or conservation category, a species-wide wild diet and life-history synthesis, or population-wide mortality. Each result remains tied to its sampled population, place, period and method.
readerLimitations.zh: 这些来源没有确定当前全球分布或保育类别，也没有综合整个物种的野外饮食、生活史或种群死亡率。每项结果仍受其采样群体、地点、时期和方法限制。

geography: Lake Manyara National Park, Tanzania (wild road-transect study, 2011–2019)
Gombe National Park, Tanzania (wild reproductive records, 1972–2002)
CNRS Primatology Station, Rousset-sur-Arc, France (captive longitudinal cohort)
overview: COL26.8 accepts Papio anubis. The selected sources cover one captive growth cohort, long-term pregnancy records at Gombe, a Lake Manyara survey-method comparison and a small comparative-genomic panel. These studies answer separate questions rather than describe the species as a whole.

ecology.diet: Not assessed in the selected core studies.
ecology.habitat: The Lake Manyara paper compares road-transect estimates with a sleeping-site-based upper limit; roads are a possible source of sampling bias, not a full habitat account.
ecology.locomotion: Not assessed in the selected core studies.
ecology.bodySize: A seven-year captive cohort study measured segmental morphometrics from infancy to adulthood; its growth pattern is not a species-wide body-size estimate.
ecology.guild: Not assessed in the selected core studies.

traits: In one seven-year captive cohort, measured size and shape were similar at birth; later differences in growth rate and duration produced substantial size differences while measured body shape remained similar.
evidenceSummary: The evidence includes a seven-year captive cohort, 732 pregnancies among 175 Gombe females, road-transect estimates compared with a sleeping-site upper limit, and a 12-animal panel with 4,645 Alu indicator loci. These samples do not establish global range, current conservation status, full diet or movement, or complete evolutionary history.

title.en: Growth, pregnancy and survey methods
title.zh: 生长、妊娠与调查方法

text.zh: 圈养队列记录从幼年到成年的生长；贡贝资料分析妊娠结果及其与降雨、等级的关联；Manyara 湖研究比较两种密度估算方法。这些材料涉及生活的不同侧面，不能合成一个全物种估计。
text.en: The captive cohort measured growth from infancy to adulthood. Gombe records describe pregnancy outcomes and their associations with rainfall and rank; Lake Manyara compares two density-estimation approaches. These materials cover different aspects of life and do not yield one species-wide estimate.

title.en: Four study settings, four evidence scales
title.zh: 四种研究地点与证据尺度

text.en: COL26.8 accepts the name Papio anubis. The studies come from a captive station in France, long-term wild records at Gombe, a survey-method study at Lake Manyara and a comparative-genomic panel. Each has its own population, method and limits; together they do not describe every population.
text.zh: COL26.8 接受 Papio anubis 这个名称。研究分别来自法国圈养研究站、贡贝长期野外记录、Manyara 湖调查方法研究和比较基因组面板。每项研究都有自己的种群、方法和边界，不能代表所有橄榄狒狒种群。

title.en: Growth measured in one captive cohort
title.zh: 一个圈养队列中的生长测量

text.en: A seven-year longitudinal study at the CNRS primatology station followed 14 females and 16 males from at least two months of age to adulthood. Size and shape were similar at birth; later differences in growth rate and duration produced substantial size differences while measured body-shape patterns remained similar. This is not a wild growth curve.
text.zh: 法国国家科学研究中心灵长类研究站的一项七年纵向研究，跟踪了 14 只雌性和 16 只雄性，从至少两月龄观察到成年。出生时测量的体型和形状相近；之后生长速度和持续时间不同，形成明显体型差异，而测量到的身体形状模式仍相近。这不是野外生长曲线。

title.en: Gombe miscarriages and changing rank associations
title.zh: 贡贝流产记录与等级关联

text.en: Gombe records from 1972–2002 covered 732 pregnancies among 175 females of known rank; 65 ended in miscarriage. Rank-related patterns varied with rainfall and immigration of males that rose rapidly to top rank. When mean rainfall over two years fell below about 1,100 mm, the rank-linked pattern largely disappeared. These are observational associations, not a species-wide rate or proof of cause.
text.zh: 贡贝 1972—2002 年资料涵盖 175 只已知等级雌性的 732 次妊娠，其中 65 次以流产告终。等级关联随降雨及快速升至最高等级的移入雄性而变化；两年平均降雨低于约 1,100 毫米时，等级相关模式大体消失。这些是观察性关联，不是全物种流产率或因果证明。

title.en: Road transects versus a sleeping-site upper limit
title.zh: 道路样线与夜宿点上限的比较

text.en: At Lake Manyara, road-transect surveys from 2011–2019 produced density estimates more than three times an upper limit derived from sleeping-site counts and average group size. The authors identified baboons' road use as a possible source of bias. This method comparison is not an estimate of total park population or trend.
text.zh: 坦桑尼亚 Manyara 湖 2011—2019 年道路样线调查得出的密度估计，超过根据夜宿点计数和平均群体大小推算上限的三倍。作者指出狒狒使用道路可能造成偏差。这是对一个地点调查方法的比较，不是公园总种群或趋势估计。

title.en: A comparative panel of 12 baboons
title.zh: 由 12 只个体组成的比较基因组面板

text.en: A phylogeny study sampled two animals from each of six extant baboon species, 12 individuals total. Within that panel, the authors identified 4,645 Alu insertion sites as P. anubis indicator loci under their method. This marker result does not summarize within-species variation or settle the full evolutionary history.
text.zh: 一项 Papio 系统发育研究为六个现生狒狒种各采样两只，共 12 只个体。按作者的方法，面板中有 4,645 个 Alu 插入位点被识别为 P. anubis 指示位点。该标记结果不能概括种内遗传变异，也不能定论完整演化史。

title.en: Limits of these study samples
title.zh: 这些研究仍未确定什么

text.en: The selected sources do not establish a full current distribution, formal conservation status, a species-wide wild diet or locomotion synthesis, or a complete fossil and evolutionary history. Each result remains bounded by the sample and method described.
text.zh: 所选来源没有确定完整现今分布、正式保育状态、全物种野外食谱或运动综合，也没有提供完整化石记录和演化史。每项结论都受相应样本和方法限制。

geography: Mysore-connected roadside transects, Karnataka, India (comparative counts, 2003 and 2015; study site)
Parambikulam landscape, Kerala, India (one forest occupancy survey)
Southern Indian temple/tourist locations (historical site-status comparison)
Southern India (82 fecal-derived host mtDNA D-loop sequences from 16 sampled locations; collected 2014–15; study sampling frame, not a range boundary)
overview: COL26.8 lists Macaca radiata as a species. Selected southern Indian surveys, a museum comparison across macaque species and a mitochondrial D-loop study address different questions. None is a current range map or a species-wide population trend.

ecology.diet: Not assessed in the selected study.
ecology.habitat: At Parambikulam, 54 groups were detected in 33 of 64 grid cells and modelled mean occupancy was 0.51 ± 0.08 (SE); this is one forest survey, not a complete habitat account.
ecology.locomotion: Not assessed in the selected study.
ecology.bodySize: Not assessed in the selected study.
ecology.guild: Not assessed as a broader species-level ecological guild.

evidenceSummary: One 2017 study combined local forest, roadside and temple records; a 2018 comparison examined 711 specimens from 12 macaque species, including 79 bonnet macaques. A separate study analyzed 82 fecal-derived mitochondrial D-loop sequences from 16 southern Indian locations. These designs do not establish within-species diagnostic variation or genome-wide structure; the proposed human-mediated translocation explanation remains a hypothesis.

title.en: Different materials, different scales
title.zh: 身体、生活与关系

text.zh: 博物馆中的颅牙标本与印度南部的森林、道路和寺庙记录，提供了认识冠猕猴的不同材料。标本比较针对猕猴属的种间差异，地方调查则研究规定区域内的出现与计数变化。两者需要各自的范围，才能避免把局地结果当成整个物种的规律。
text.en: Bonnet macaque evidence here includes local counts and occupancy estimates, site histories, museum craniodental specimens and mitochondrial sequences. Each source measures a different thing. The sections retain those differences instead of combining them into one range-wide account.

title.en: Records from selected southern Indian sites
title.zh: 地方记录与博物馆样本的范围

text.en: The COL26.8 checklist accepts Macaca radiata. The selected studies cover particular forests, roads, temples and tourist sites in southern India, plus museum specimens used for a cross-species comparison. They do not provide a current range map or full population trend.
text.zh: 固定版本 COL26.8 接受 Macaca radiata。所选研究覆盖印度南部若干森林、道路、寺庙和旅游地点，也包括用于猕猴属种间比较的博物馆标本。它们没有提供当前分布图或完整种群趋势。

title.en: Occupancy estimate in Parambikulam
title.zh: Parambikulam 的占域估计

text.en: In one Kerala survey, observers detected 54 groups in 33 of 64 grid cells. The fitted mean occupancy was 0.51 ? 0.08 (SE), with detection probability 0.25 ? 0.05. Occupancy is the modeled share of sampled cells used; these values belong to that survey and its design.
text.zh: 喀拉拉邦一次调查在 64 个网格中的 33 个记录到 54 个群体。模型估计平均占域率为 0.51 ± 0.08（标准误），检测概率为 0.25 ± 0.05。占域率是模型估算的已使用样本网格比例；这些数值仅适用于该调查设计。

title.en: Roadside counts on routes connected to Mysore
title.zh: 连接迈索尔道路上的路边计数

text.en: Counts fell from 889 in 2003 to 407 in 2015 on roads connected to Mysore. The 2015 resurvey covered 464 km and a 15-m strip on each side of the road centreline. The change describes animals visible in that survey band, not a census across southern India.
text.zh: 连接迈索尔的道路调查计数从 2003 年的 889 只降至 2015 年的 407 只。2015 年复查覆盖 464 公里，调查带为道路中心线两侧各 15 米。变化描述的是该调查带内可见个体，不是印度南部的全物种普查。

title.en: Temple and tourist-site histories
title.zh: 寺庙与旅游地点的历史记录

text.en: The study assessed selected sites using historical records and follow-up surveys from 2009?2015. About 31% recorded bonnet macaques. Among reported translocations, roughly one fifth were followed by reappearance; more than 48% were recorded as disappearance or removal. These site histories do not establish present occupancy across the range.
text.zh: 研究用历史记录和 2009—2015 年复查评估了部分地点。约 31% 的受评地点记录到冠猕猴。在报告的迁移案例中，约五分之一随后有重新出现记录；超过 48% 被记录为消失或清除。地点史不能确定全分布区的现今占域情况。

title.en: Bonnet macaques in a 12-species museum comparison
title.zh: 12 种猕猴的博物馆标本比较

text.en: The 2018 comparison covered 711 specimens from 12 macaque species, including 79 M. radiata (46 males, 33 females) attributed to southern and western India; subadults were included. The reported weak latitudinal pattern is interspecific. Mixed origins and cross-species sampling do not establish diagnostic traits or variation within bonnet macaques.
text.zh: 2018 年比较研究涵盖 12 种猕猴的 711 件标本，其中 79 件冠猕猴标本（雄性 46 件、雌性 33 件）标注来自印度南部和西部，也包括亚成体。论文报告的是较弱的种间纬度模式。标本来源混杂且设计针对种间比较，不能据此确定冠猕猴的诊断性状或种内变异。

title.en: What the selected studies do not establish
title.zh: 这些研究仍未确定什么

text.en: The sources do not synthesize life history, diet, locomotion, full distribution or current formal conservation category. A local recommendation in the 2017 paper is neither a statutory designation nor a current independent status assessment.

Mitochondrial lineage and HVR-I studies address sampled genetic variation. Together these sources do not provide a range-wide or annual ecological synthesis.

title.en: One field troop, separate genetic samples
title.zh: 野外观察与遗传样本分别回答什么问题

text.zh: Puthuthottam 研究中的森林内部、林缘和开阔斑块提供了不同取食环境。一项研究在旱季跟踪一个猴群，遗传研究则比较西高止山脉各地的线粒体样本。这些记录描述地方行为和受采样谱系，并非该物种的完整综述。
text.en: Feeding and activity were recorded from one Puthuthottam troop in 2016; mitochondrial studies sampled animals or fragments at Western Ghats sites. A separate seed-dispersal result remains a version-one preprint. Each line of evidence has its own sample and scope.

title.en: Wild samples from 15 Western Ghats sites
title.zh: 西高止山脉的采样

text.en: A 2010–2012 genetic study sampled wild animals at 15 sites in Karnataka, Kerala and Tamil Nadu, with captive blood samples identified separately. Those sites describe the study's sampling frame, not the full present-day range.
text.zh: 一项 2010—2012 年遗传研究在卡纳塔克邦、喀拉拉邦和泰米尔纳德邦的 15 个地点采集野生样本，另行分析了明确标注的圈养血液样本。这些是研究采样地点，不是完整的现今分布图。

title.en: Activity in one Puthuthottam troop
title.zh: Puthuthottam 一个猴群的活动观察

text.en: From February to May 2016, researchers followed one habituated troop for more than 480 hours across forest interior, edge, an open patch and a settlement. Active foraging was higher in the open patch and edge, and lower in the settlement than in the interior. The comparison covers one troop and one dry season.
text.zh: 2016 年 2 月至 5 月，研究者在林内、林缘、开阔斑块和聚居地跟踪一个已习惯观察的猴群，累计超过 480 小时。开阔斑块与林缘的主动觅食较多，聚居地则少于林内。该比较仅涉及一个猴群和一个旱季。

title.en: Foods recorded in the 2016 troop
title.zh: 2016 年猴群记录到的食物

text.en: The troop ate parts from 19 plant species as well as non-plant foods. In the habitat comparisons, invertebrate feeding was more frequent in the open patch than in forest interior, while plant feeding was greater in the interior than at the edge. These observations are not a complete species diet.
text.zh: 该猴群取食了 19 种植物的不同部分，也摄食非植物食物。栖地比较显示，开阔斑块中的无脊椎动物取食多于林内；林内植物取食多于林缘。观察结果不代表该物种的完整食谱。

title.en: A four-group result from a version-one preprint
title.zh: 来自第一版预印本的四群体结果

text.en: A version-one 2024 bioRxiv preprint reports 375.9 hours of focal observations across four groups in a 92-hectare Puduthottam fragment. Subadults consumed a greater variety of native and non-native fruits than adults and dispersed fewer Ficus seeds than adult females. The sampling year is not reported.
text.zh: 一篇 2024 年 bioRxiv 第一版预印本报告，在 Puduthottam 一处 92 公顷森林碎片中，对四个群体开展了 375.9 小时焦点观察。亚成体取食的本地与非本地水果种类多于成年个体，传播的 Ficus 种子少于成年雌性。研究未报告采样年份。

title.en: A fossil-calibrated mitochondrial estimate
title.zh: 化石校准的线粒体年代估计

text.en: A Western Ghats study distinguished sampled mitochondrial lineages north and south of the Palghat Gap. A fossil-calibrated model using 893 mitochondrial bases estimated their mean most-recent common ancestor at 2.11 million years ago. This is not a nuclear species tree or a direct fossil date for the species' origin.
text.zh: 一项西高止山脉研究区分了 Palghat 缺口南北受采样的线粒体谱系。使用 893 个线粒体碱基的化石校准模型，将其最近共同祖先平均时间估为 211 万年前。这不是核基因组物种树，也不是该物种起源的直接化石年代。

title.en: HVR-I diversity in eight Anamalai fragments
title.zh: 阿纳马莱八个森林碎片的 HVR-I 多样性

text.en: A separate study compared HVR-I mitochondrial samples from eight Anamalai forest fragments with nearby continuous-forest samples and found lower diversity in fragments. This describes the sampled marker and sites; it does not measure population viability or extinction risk.
text.zh: 另一项研究比较了阿纳马莱八个森林碎片的 HVR-I 线粒体样本与附近连续森林样本，发现碎片样本多样性较低。结果描述的是受采样标记和地点，不能直接测量种群存续能力或灭绝风险。

title.en: What these studies leave unresolved

title.en: From adult appearance to sampled lineages
title.zh: 从成体外貌到受采样谱系

text.zh: 成体毛色比较、监测记录和遗传样本各有不同边界。下文分别说明：毛色特征存在重叠，出现图反映汇编记录，圈养研究不能代表野外估计，线粒体年代只适用于所采样谱系。
text.en: Adult coat comparisons, surveillance records and genetic samples each have distinct limits. The sections below retain those boundaries: coat traits overlap, occurrence maps reflect compiled records, colony results are not wild estimates, and the mitochondrial date applies to sampled lineages.

title.en: Adult coat traits in a comparative sample
title.zh: 比较样本中的成体毛色特征

text.en: From 2015 to 2019, researchers compared 30 adult C. jacchus with 209 adult Callithrix from wild and captive sources. They described grey-tipped crown hairs, a grey chin, white ear tufts, a forehead star and dark or grey dorsal bands over orange underfur. Means of 13 traits did not differ significantly from C. penicillata in this sample; the description is not a stand-alone field test.
text.zh: 2015 至 2019 年，研究者比较了 30 只成年普通狨与来自野外和圈养来源的 209 只成年柽柳猴。论文描述了灰色毛尖、灰色颏部、白色耳簇、额部星斑，以及覆盖橙色底毛的深色或灰白背毛。在该样本中，13 项特征均值与黑耳狨没有显著差异；这些描述不是单独的野外鉴定法。

title.en: Native and introduced records in the compilation
title.zh: 汇编中的原生与引入记录

text.en: The presence-only compilation classified northeastern Brazil's coastal and inland records as native, and records in S?o Paulo, Paran?, Rio de Janeiro and Minas Gerais as introductions. Observed records are separate from modeled habitat suitability. The compilation cannot define the complete range or show absence where no record was collected.
text.zh: 这份仅含出现点的汇编将巴西东北部沿海和内陆记录归为原生，将圣保罗、巴拉那、里约热内卢和米纳斯吉拉斯的记录归为引入。实地记录与模型预测的栖地适宜性是不同证据；汇编不能界定完整分布，也不能证明无记录处没有本种。

title.en: Paternal responses in one captive colony
title.zh: 一个圈养群体中的父亲回应研究

text.en: At a Wisconsin research colony, investigators tested 24 experienced fathers' responses to infant distress calls and followed 62 offspring. Offspring of fathers classed as responsive were more likely to survive beyond one month (p = 0.002); group weights also differed at weeks 28 and 30. This is a captive-colony association, not a wild survival estimate or proof of causation.
text.zh: 威斯康星一处研究圈养群体中，研究者测试了 24 位有育幼经验父亲对幼体求救叫声的反应，并追踪 62 只后代。被归为会回应的父亲，其后代超过一个月后存活的可能性较高（p = 0.002）；第 28 和 30 周的组间体重也有差异。这是圈养群体中的关联，不是野外存活率或因果证明。

title.en: Brazilian passive rabies reports, 2008?2020
title.zh: 2008—2020 年巴西狂犬病上报记录

text.en: Brazil's Ministry of Health recorded 67 reported outbreaks, 91 cases and 41 municipalities involving common marmosets from January 2008 through October 2020. The study also reported spillover of a Desmodus rotundus antigenic variant in northern and southern reporting areas. These surveillance records do not measure prevalence across the species' range.
text.zh: 巴西卫生部在 2008 年 1 月至 2020 年 10 月间记录了涉及普通狨的 67 起上报疫情、91 例病例，分布于 41 个市镇。研究还报告吸血蝠（Desmodus rotundus）抗原变异株在北部和南部报告区域发生溢出。这些监测记录不能测量整个分布区的患病率。

title.en: Maternal haplotypes in 18 putative hybrids
title.zh: 18 只疑似杂交个体中的母系单倍型

text.en: At four southeastern Brazilian localities, five of 18 free-living marmosets with putative hybrid appearance carried a C. jacchus maternal COX2 haplotype. The authors discuss hybridization involving threatened native C. aurita and introduced congeners as a conservation concern. This sample does not estimate hybrid frequency, population effects or formal status.
text.zh: 巴西东南部四地采集的 18 只自由活动、外形疑似杂交绒猴中，有 5 只带有普通狨母系 COX2 单倍型。作者将受威胁原生种 C. aurita 与引入近缘种之间的杂交列为保育关注。该样本没有估算杂交频率、种群影响或正式保育状态。

title.en: A mitochondrial estimate for sampled lineages
title.zh: 受采样线粒体谱系的年代估计

text.en: One study combined 49 newly sequenced Callithrix mitogenomes with published sequences. Its model placed sampled C. jacchus and Caatinga C. penicillata lineages as sisters, with an estimated divergence near 0.51 million years ago. This is a mitochondrial-lineage estimate, not a nuclear species tree or a definitive species-origin date.
text.zh: 一项研究将新测序的 49 个柽柳猴属线粒体基因组与已发表序列合并。模型估计，所采样的普通狨与卡廷加地区黑耳狨谱系互为姐妹，约在 51 万年前分化。这是线粒体谱系估计，不是核基因组物种树，也不是确定的物种起源日期。

geography: Archaeological sample sites south of the Limpopo River across central and southern South Africa; 28 sampled individuals date to 10,200–150 calibrated years before present.
Tam Pà Ling cave, northern Laos; TPL 6 and TPL 7 are associated with sediment-age models, not direct fossil dates.
Ilsenhöhle at Ranis, Germany; a cave diet study analyzed 10 human remains alongside 52 animal remains.
Ust’-Ishim, western Siberia; one directly dated femur and its genome do not delimit the species range.
overview: The accepted name Homo sapiens covers a history wider than any single fossil or genome. The examples here include two Laos fossils dated from surrounding sediments, a Ranis isotope sample, a southern African genomic cohort and one directly dated Siberian femur. Their places, methods and limits remain distinct.

ecology.diet: At Ilsenhöhle in Ranis, collagen isotopes from 10 human remains, interpreted with 52 animal remains, indicated a large-terrestrial-mammal diet in a cold steppe–tundra setting. This single cave sample does not describe Homo sapiens generally.

evidenceSummary: The examples include TPL 6 and TPL 7 at Tam Pà Ling, 10 human and 52 faunal remains from Ranis, 28 people from southern African archaeological sites and one Ust’-Ishim femur. Sediment estimates, calibrated context dates, genomic comparisons and a direct radiocarbon date answer different questions.

title.en: Bones, cave chemistry and ancient DNA
title.zh: 骨骼、洞穴化学与古 DNA

text.zh: 额骨碎片、胫骨近端、骨胶原同位素和古基因组提供不同类型的证据。Tam Pà Ling 年代来自周边沉积物；Ust’-Ishim 经直接测年；Ranis 骨胶原则用于分析饮食信号。每项结果都应与材料、方法和地点对应。
text.en: A frontal-bone fragment, a proximal tibia, collagen isotopes and ancient genomes are different evidence. Tam Pà Ling ages come from surrounding sediments; Ust’-Ishim was directly dated; Ranis collagen was analyzed for dietary signals. Each finding stays tied to its material, method and place.

title.en: No single study covers human history
title.zh: 没有一项研究覆盖整个智人历史

text.en: The pinned COL26.8 checklist accepts Homo sapiens. These studies examine particular fossils, archaeological settings and genomic samples. They cannot be combined into a complete account of human origins, present-day diversity or migration.
text.zh: 固定版 COL26.8 清单接受 Homo sapiens。这里的研究考察特定化石、考古环境和群体基因组样本，回答的问题各不相同，不能拼成完整的人类起源、当代多样性或迁徙叙事。

title.en: Contextual ages for TPL 6 and TPL 7
title.zh: TPL 6 与 TPL 7 的背景年代

text.en: At Tam Pà Ling cave in northern Laos, TPL 6 is a left frontal-bone fragment and TPL 7 the upper end of a left tibia, both attributed to H. sapiens. Sediment-based models estimate 70 ± 3 thousand years for TPL 6 and as old as 77 ± 9 thousand years for TPL 7. These are contextual, not direct bone dates; TPL 7 may be older, and post-burial alteration limits measurement.
text.zh: 老挝北部 Tam Pà Ling 洞穴的 TPL 6 是左额骨碎片，TPL 7 是左胫骨上端，论文将两者归为 H. sapiens。依据周边沉积物模型估计，TPL 6 为 70 ± 3 千年，TPL 7 最早可达 77 ± 9 千年。这些是背景估计而非骨骼直接测年；作者指出 TPL 7 可能更早，埋藏后改造也限制了测量。

title.en: Ranis collagen isotopes and a cave-specific diet signal
title.zh: Ranis 骨胶原同位素与洞穴饮食信号

text.en: At Ilsenhöhle in Ranis, researchers measured collagen isotopes from 10 human remains and compared them with 52 animal remains from the same archaeological setting. Results indicate a large-terrestrial-mammal diet in a cold steppe–tundra environment. The layers date to about 47,500–45,770 and 46,820–43,260 calibrated years before present; these are not direct dates for each human bone. One cave cannot define human diets generally.
text.zh: 德国 Ranis 的 Ilsenhöhle 洞穴中，研究者测量了 10 份人类遗骸骨胶原同位素，并与同一考古环境的 52 份动物遗骸比较。结果指向寒冷草原—苔原环境中以大型陆生哺乳动物为主的饮食。地层年代约为距今 47,500–45,770 年和 46,820–43,260 年（校正值），不是每块人骨的直接年代。一处洞穴不能代表一般人类饮食。

title.en: A 28-person genomic comparison south of the Limpopo
title.zh: 林波波河以南的 28 人基因组比较

text.en: A whole-genome study analyzed 28 people from archaeological sites south of the Limpopo in central and southern Africa, spanning 10,200 to 150 calibrated years before present. In that study's comparison panel, samples older than 1,400 years fell outside the variation represented by its modern samples and carried many variants the authors classified as H. sapiens-specific. The result depends on the sampled and comparison individuals and the authors' definitions.
text.zh: 一项全基因组研究分析了林波波河以南、非洲中部和南部考古地点的 28 名个体，样本年代跨度为距今 10,200 至 150 个校准年。在其比较面板中，早于 1,400 年的样本落在该研究现生人群所代表的变异范围之外，并带有许多作者归类为 H. sapiens 特异的变异。结果取决于样本、现生比较组和变异定义。

title.en: One directly dated Ust’-Ishim femur
title.zh: 经直接测年的一根 Ust’-Ishim 股骨

text.en: The Ust’-Ishim 1 femur from western Siberia has a direct radiocarbon age of 46,880–43,210 calibrated years before present at 95.4% probability. The genome comes from this one person; the date is not the origin of H. sapiens or the species' first or last appearance.
text.zh: 西西伯利亚 Ust’-Ishim 1 股骨经直接放射性碳测年，95.4% 概率区间为距今 46,880–43,210 个校准年。基因组对应一名受测者。该年代不是 H. sapiens 的起源时间，也不是物种首末出现范围。

title.en: Separate sites do not make one migration route
title.zh: 不同地点不能连成一条迁徙路线

text.en: The Laos fossils, Ranis diet signal, Siberian individual and southern African genomes differ in place, dating method and question. Together they provide several views of ancient H. sapiens, not a continuous migration route or the species' current range.
text.zh: 老挝化石、Ranis 饮食信号、西伯利亚个体和南部非洲古基因组的地点、测年方法与研究问题不同。它们提供观察古代 H. sapiens 的若干窗口，却不能组成连续迁徙路线，也不能说明该物种当前完整的地理分布。
